title: Isikhathi sokuphumula
description: Ten short, simple stories about free time and hobbies: a police film on a Friday night, a quiz evening, a Saturday race, a train trip south to Cape Town, fishing on the Thukela, a photo show at the library, joining a football team, watching ships in Durban, a quiet life on a farm and a Freedom Day gathering.

lessons.title: Ifilimu yamaphoyisa
lessons.summary: Friends Phumlani and Thandiwe go to a new police film in Durban on a Friday night: a woman finds a body and a gun, the killer runs away and is caught, and Thandiwe, who dislikes the violence, wants a film without it next Friday.
lessons.text:
UPhumlani noThandiwe bangabangane. Bahlala eThekwini, futhi bobabili bathanda amafilimu kakhulu. Njalo ngoLwesihlanu ebusuku baya kubona ifilimu entsha.

Ngolunye uLwesihlanu uPhumlani uthi: "Mngane wami, kukhona ifilimu entsha yamaphoyisa. Umkhiqizi wayo ungumkhiqizi odumile waseThekwini." UThandiwe uthi: "Kulungile. Asihambe!"

Ifilimu iqala ngehora 8. Endaweni yamafilimu kunabantu abaningi. Abangane bahlala phambili.

Efilimini owesifazane ufika ekhaya ebusuku. Uthola isidumbu sendoda endlini yakhe. Phansi, ngaphandle kwesidumbu, kukhona isibhamu. Owesifazane ushayela amaphoyisa ucingo.

Iphoyisa liyafika. Libheka isidumbu, libheke nesibhamu. Lithi: "Lesi sibhamu yisikhali esabulala le ndoda." Iphoyisa lifuna umuntu owasebenzisa lesi sikhali.

Ngemuva kwezinsuku ezimbili iphoyisa lithola indoda. Kodwa indoda iyabaleka ngemoto. Iphoyisa liyayilandela endleleni. Ekugcineni indoda ayikwazi ukubaleka futhi. Iphoyisa liyayibamba, liyifake ejele. Indoda izohlala ejele iminyaka eminingi.

Ifilimu le inodlame oluningi. Kunezibhamu eziningi nezinye izikhali. UThandiwe akakuthandi ukubona udlame. Uvala amehlo kaningi.

Ifilimu iyaphela, abantu bayaphuma. UPhumlani uthi: "Ifilimu le yinhle kakhulu!" UThandiwe uthi: "Cha, mngane wami. Udlame lwayo luningi kakhulu. NgoLwesihlanu olulandelayo asibone ifilimu yothando." UPhumlani uyavuma. Uthi: "Kulungile. Umkhiqizi wayo wenza namafilimu othando."

Imibuzo:
UPhumlani noThandiwe bangabangane na?
Kunjalo, bangabangane.
Baya kubona ifilimu ngoLwesihlanu na?
Kunjalo, baya ngoLwesihlanu ebusuku.
Owesifazane uthola isidumbu endlini yakhe na?
Kunjalo, uthola isidumbu sendoda endlini yakhe.
Indoda ihlala ekhaya na?
Cha, iphoyisa liyayibamba, liyifake ejele.
UThandiwe uthanda udlame na?
Cha, akakuthandi ukubona udlame.

lessons.title: Impendulo efanele
lessons.summary: At a Wednesday quiz in Pietermaritzburg, Nomathemba and Vusi argue over which king ruled at Isandlwana and write Cetshwayo; a loud man from another team who wrote Dingane calls it lies, until the quiz leader shows him the page.
lessons.text:
UNomathemba noVusi bahlala eMgungundlovu. Njalo ngoLwesithathu ebusuku baya esikoleni sendawo yabo. Lapho abantu bendawo badlala umdlalo wemibuzo. Kunamaqembu amahlanu. UNomathemba noVusi bayiqembu elincane labantu ababili.

Iqembu ngalinye lithola iphepha. Owesifazane uthi: "Ngizobuza, nina nibhale izimpendulo zenu ephepheni. Impendulo efanele ngayinye iyiphuzu elilodwa."

Owesifazane uyabuza: "Ngubani inkosi ngesikhathi sempi yaseSandlwana?"

UVusi uthi: "NguDingane." UNomathemba uyaphika. Uthi: "Cha, akusiye uDingane. NguCetshwayo." UVusi uthi: "Mhlawumbe ulungile, kodwa angazi kahle." Bayaphika kancane. Bese uVusi uyabuza: "Yiphi impendulo efanele? Ngicabanga ukuthi wena wazi kangcono." UNomathemba ubhala uCetshwayo ephepheni.

Eqenjini elilandelayo kukhona indoda enezwi elikhulu. Ikhuluma kakhulu, iphazamisa wonke umuntu. UVusi uthi: "Le ndoda iyangiphazamisa. Angikwazi ukucabanga." UNomathemba uthi: "Mhlawumbe izothula manje."

Ekugcineni owesifazane uthatha wonke amaphepha. Uqhathanisa izimpendulo zamaqembu. Ngemuva kokuthi aqhathanise amaphepha, uthi: "Iqembu likaNomathemba noVusi linamaphuzu amaningi. Iqembu lendoda enezwi elikhulu lenze iphutha: libhale uDingane."

Indoda iyamphikisa. Ithi: "Cha! Lokho kungamanga! Impendulo yethu ifanele."

Owesifazane uvula incwadi endala. Ukhombisa indoda ikhasi elilodwa. Uthi: "Angikhulumi amanga. Bheka ikhasi leli. Lithi inkosi ngesikhathi sempi yaseSandlwana nguCetshwayo." Indoda ifunda ikhasi. Ayimphikisi futhi. Ithi: "Ngenze iphutha."

UVusi uthi kuNomathemba: "Yiphi impendulo yami efanele namuhla? Ayikho! Wena wazi izimpendulo eziningi kunami."

Imibuzo:
UNomathemba noVusi badlala ngoLwesithathu na?
Kunjalo, badlala njalo ngoLwesithathu ebusuku.
UVusi uthi inkosi nguCetshwayo na?
Cha, uthi nguDingane, kodwa uNomathemba uyaphika.
Indoda enezwi elikhulu iyabaphazamisa na?
Kunjalo, iphazamisa wonke umuntu.
Iqembu lendoda lenze iphutha na?
Kunjalo, libhale uDingane.
Owesifazane ukhombisa indoda ikhasi lencwadi na?
Kunjalo, ukhombisa indoda ikhasi elilodwa.

lessons.title: USindisiwe uyagijima
lessons.summary: Sindisiwe from Soweto runs a big Saturday race on a full stomach; it aches on the climb, she falls near the top, gets up and finishes sixth, and promises her mother she will win the gold next year.
lessons.text:
USindisiwe uhlala eSoweto. Uthanda ukugijima. Njalo ekuseni ugijima ezindleleni zendawo yakhe.

NgoMgqibelo kukhona ukugijima okukhulu eSoweto. Abantu abangamakhulu amabili bazogijima amakhilomitha ayisithupha. Imboni enkulu yaseGoli ixhasa lokhu kugijima. Unina kaSindisiwe uyamthanda kakhulu, futhi uyamxhasa naye: umnika imali yezingubo ezintsha zokugijima.

NgoMgqibelo ekuseni uSindisiwe udla ukudla okuningi. Ngemuva kwesikhathi esincane isisu sakhe siqala ukuba buhlungu. Unina uthi: "Uma isisu sakho sibuhlungu, ungagijimi namuhla." USindisiwe uthi: "Cha, Mama. Ngifuna ukugijima."

Ukugijima kuqala ngehora 7. USindisiwe ugijima kahle. Bese abagijimi bakhuphuka intaba. USindisiwe ukhuphuka kancane, ngoba isisu sakhe sibuhlungu futhi. Phezulu entabeni uyawa. Isandla sakhe sinegazi kancane.

Kodwa uSindisiwe uyavuka. Akafuni ukuyeka. Uqhubeka nokugijima. Ekugcineni ufeza ukugijima. Ukhathele kakhulu, kodwa uyajabula. Abagijimi abahlanu bafika ngaphambi kwakhe. USindisiwe ungowesithupha.

Owesifazane wokuqala uthola igolide. USindisiwe ubheka igolide. Uthi kunina: "Ngonyaka ozayo nami ngizothola igolide."

Unina uthi: "Ngiyakukholwa. Namuhla uwile, kodwa uvukile, waqhubeka, wakufeza ukugijima. Ngizokuxhasa futhi."

Imibuzo:
Ukugijima okukhulu kungoMgqibelo na?
Kunjalo, kungoMgqibelo eSoweto.
Isisu sikaSindisiwe sibuhlungu na?
Kunjalo, isisu sakhe sibuhlungu, ngoba udle ukudla okuningi.
USindisiwe uyawa entabeni na?
Kunjalo, uyawa phezulu entabeni, kodwa uyavuka.
USindisiwe ufeza ukugijima na?
Kunjalo, ufeza ukugijima, futhi ungowesithupha.
USindisiwe uthola igolide na?
Cha, owesifazane wokuqala uthola igolide.

lessons.title: Isitimela esiya eKapa
lessons.summary: Khayalethu from Johannesburg takes the train south to visit his friend Ofentse in Cape Town: he pays for his seat, carries his heavy luggage aboard, finds space for it with a stranger's help and rides straight through to Cape Town.
lessons.text:
UKhayalethu uhlala eGoli. Umngane wakhe, uOfentse, uhlala eKapa, eningizimu yezwe. Kulo nyaka uKhayalethu ufuna ukuvakashela umngane wakhe.

Akafuni ukuhamba ngemoto, ngoba indlela inde kakhulu. Ufuna ukuhamba ngesitimela. Isitimela sihamba ngqo sisuka eGoli siye eKapa.

UKhayalethu uya endaweni yezitimela. Ubuza intengo yesihlalo. Owesifazane uthi: "Intengo yesihlalo incane." UKhayalethu ukhokhela isihlalo sakhe. Owesifazane uthi: "Isitimela semuka ngoMsombuluko ngehora 10."

NgoMsombuluko ekuseni uKhayalethu uthwala umthwalo wakhe. Umthwalo wakhe mkhulu, ngoba unezinto eziningi zomngane wakhe. Uwuthwala ngezandla zombili.

Ngehora 10 isitimela siyemuka. UKhayalethu uthola isihlalo sakhe. Kodwa phezulu akukho isikhala somthwalo wakhe. Indoda ethile ithi: "Beka umthwalo wakho lapha. Kunesikhala." UKhayalethu uthi: "Ngiyakubonga." Ubeka umthwalo esikhaleni.

Isitimela sihamba ngqo siye eningizimu. Sidlula amadolobha amaningi nezintaba eziningi. UKhayalethu ubheka izwe. Ebusuku ulala esihlalweni sakhe.

Ngosuku olulandelayo isitimela sifika eKapa. UOfentse ulindile. Uthi: "Wamukelekile, mngane wami! Ngiyajabula ukuthi uyangivakashela." UOfentse uthwala umthwalo kaKhayalethu. Bahamba ngqo baye ekhaya.

Imibuzo:
UOfentse uhlala eningizimu yezwe na?
Kunjalo, uhlala eKapa, eningizimu yezwe.
UKhayalethu ukhokhela isihlalo sakhe na?
Kunjalo, ukhokhela isihlalo sakhe.
Isitimela semuka ngehora 10 na?
Kunjalo, semuka ngoMsombuluko ngehora 10.
Kukhona isikhala somthwalo phezulu na?
Cha, akukho, kodwa indoda ethile imnika isikhala.
Ubani othwala umthwalo eKapa?
UOfentse uthwala umthwalo kaKhayalethu.

lessons.title: Inhlanzi yomfula
lessons.summary: Old Mfanafuthi and his grandson Lindo unfasten the dog and go fishing on the Thukela; after a while Lindo pulls out a fish, they eat their bread on the riverbank and give the dog what is left.
lessons.text:
UMfanafuthi uyindoda endala. Uhlala endaweni lapho umfula uThukela udlula khona. Unenja enkulu. Ebusuku inja ihlala ngaphandle entanjeni.

NgoMgqibelo uLindo, ingane yendodana yakhe, uyamvakashela. Uthi: "Mkhulu, asiye emfuleni namuhla. Ngifuna ukubamba inhlanzi."

UMfanafuthi uyayikhulula inja entanjeni. Uthi: "Nawe uzohamba nathi." ULindo uthatha isinkwa. Bahamba ngezinyawo baye emfuleni. Inja igijima phambili.

Bahlala eceleni komfula. UMfanafuthi unika uLindo intambo. Uthi: "Faka intambo emanzini. Bese ulinda isikhashana." ULindo ulinda isikhashana. Akukho lutho. Ulinda futhi isikhashana.

Bese uLindo uzwa intambo idonsa. Uthi: "Mkhulu! Kukhona into edonsayo!" UMfanafuthi uthi: "Donsa kancane!" ULindo uyidonsa intambo kancane. Uyidonsa futhi. Inhlanzi enkulu iyaphuma emanzini.

ULindo uyajabula kakhulu. Inja ifuna inhlanzi, kodwa uMfanafuthi uthi: "Cha, inja yami. Le nhlanzi ngekaLindo."

Bese bedla isinkwa eceleni komfula. ULindo uthi: "Isinkwa simnandi kakhulu lapha emfuleni." Kusala isinkwa esincane. ULindo unika inja lesi sinkwa. Inja iyasidla ngokushesha.

Ekugcineni bayabuya ekhaya. ULindo uphethe inhlanzi yakhe. Uthi: "Ukudla kwethu kwanamuhla kuzoba mnandi!"

Imibuzo:
UMfanafuthi unenja na?
Kunjalo, unenja enkulu.
UMfanafuthi uyayikhulula inja na?
Kunjalo, uyayikhulula entanjeni.
Bahlala eceleni komfula na?
Kunjalo, bahlala eceleni komfula uThukela.
ULindo uyidonsa intambo kancane na?
Kunjalo, uyidonsa kancane, futhi inhlanzi iyaphuma.
ULindo noMfanafuthi badla isinkwa sonke na?
Cha, kusala isinkwa esincane, futhi uLindo usinika inja.

lessons.title: Isithombe sikaNontobeko
lessons.summary: Nontobeko loves photography; for a show at the Pietermaritzburg library she photographs the evening light on a river, enlarges and prints her best picture, fills in the form, sends her son with it, and the library users vote for it.
lessons.text:
UNontobeko uhlala eMgungundlovu. Uthanda ubuciko kakhulu, ikakhulukazi izithombe. Uthatha izithombe ngomshini wakhe wezithombe.

Ngenyanga ezayo umtapo wolwazi wedolobha uzobonisa izithombe zabantu bendawo. Abasebenzisi bawo bazovota. Umuntu onesithombe esihle kunazo zonke uzothola imali. UNontobeko uhlose ukuthola leyo mali. Uhlose nokubonisa abantu ubuciko bakhe.

Ngesikhathi sokushona kwelanga uNontobeko uya emfuleni. Ukukhanya kwelanga kuhle kakhulu emanzini. Ubamba umshini wakhe, acindezele. Uyacindezela futhi, acindezele futhi. Uthatha izithombe eziningi.

Ekhaya uNontobeko ubheka izithombe zakhe. Ziyehluka: kwezinye ukukhanya kuncane, kwezinye ukukhanya kukhulu kakhulu. Isithombe esisodwa sehlukile kwezinye. Sihle kakhulu.

UNontobeko ufuna ukukhulisa isithombe leso. Uya esitolo. Esitolo bayasikhulisa, basishicilele. Isitolo sishicilela isithombe esikhulu. Manje ubuciko bakhe bubonakala kahle.

UNontobeko ugcwalisa iphepha lokubonisa isithombe. Ubhala igama lakhe nendawo lapho athathe khona isithombe. Uligcwalisa lonke iphepha.

Kodwa uNontobeko unomsebenzi omningi ngaleso sikhathi. Ngakho uthuma indodana yakhe. Uthi: "Hamba nesithombe nephepha edolobheni." Uyamthuma, futhi indodana yakhe iyahamba.

Ngemuva kwenyanga abasebenzisi bayavota. Abasebenzisi abaningi bavotela isithombe sikaNontobeko. UNontobeko uthola imali. Uthi: "Ngiyajabula kakhulu. Ubuciko buyimpilo yami."

Imibuzo:
UNontobeko uthanda ubuciko na?
Kunjalo, uthanda ubuciko kakhulu, ikakhulukazi izithombe.
Ukukhanya kwelanga kuhle emfuleni na?
Kunjalo, kuhle kakhulu emanzini.
Izithombe zakhe ziyafana zonke na?
Cha, ziyehluka.
UNontobeko ushicilela isithombe sakhe na?
Kunjalo, isitolo sishicilela isithombe esikhulu.
Abasebenzisi bayavota na?
Kunjalo, abaningi bavotela isithombe sikaNontobeko.

lessons.title: UQhawe ujoyina iqembu
lessons.summary: Short but fast, young Qhawe from Umlazi asks to join the local football team on a Thursday; he is hit on the head by the ball, gets up, scores, signs on, and the next Thursday scores the team's one goal in a defeat.
lessons.text:
UQhawe uyinsizwa yaseMlazi. Mfushane, kodwa uyashesha kakhulu. Uthanda ibhola, futhi ufuna ukujoyina iqembu lebhola lendawo yakhe.

Njalo ngoLwesine iqembu liqeqesha enkundleni. NgoLwesine uQhawe uya enkundleni. Ubona izinsizwa eziningi zidlala. Umqeqeshi uyambheka. Uthi: "Ufuna ukujoyina iqembu lethu? Kodwa umfushane kakhulu."

UQhawe uthi: "Ngimfushane, kodwa ngiyashesha. Ake ngidlale namuhla." Umqeqeshi uthi: "Kulungile. Dlala nathi."

UQhawe uyadlala. Ngesikhathi esincane insizwa enye ishaya ibhola ngamandla. UQhawe ushaywa yibhola ekhanda. Uyawa. Kodwa uyavuka, aqhubeke nokudlala. Ngemuva kwesikhashana ushaywa yibhola futhi, kodwa akayeki.

Ekugcineni uQhawe uthola ibhola. Ugijima ngokushesha, afake igoli elihle. Umqeqeshi uthi: "Leli yigoli elihle kakhulu! Ungajoyina iqembu lethu. Sayina leli phepha." UQhawe uyalisayina iphepha. Manje uyadlala eqenjini.

NgoLwesine olulandelayo iqembu laseMlazi lidlala neqembu lasePitoli. Iqembu lasePitoli liqinile. Lifaka amagoli amathathu. Iqembu laseMlazi liyehluleka. Kodwa uQhawe ufaka igoli elilodwa.

Umqeqeshi uthi: "Namuhla sehlulekile, kodwa uQhawe udlale kahle. Ngiyajabula ukuthi usayinile." UQhawe uthi: "NgoLwesine olulandelayo ngeke sehluleke!"

Imibuzo:
UQhawe mfushane na?
Kunjalo, mfushane, kodwa uyashesha kakhulu.
Iqembu liqeqesha ngoLwesine na?
Kunjalo, liqeqesha njalo ngoLwesine enkundleni.
UQhawe ushaywa yibhola ekhanda na?
Kunjalo, ushaywa yibhola ekhanda, kodwa uyavuka.
UQhawe uyalisayina iphepha na?
Kunjalo, uyalisayina, futhi manje uyadlala eqenjini.
Iqembu laseMlazi liyalinqoba iqembu lasePitoli na?
Cha, liyehluleka, kodwa uQhawe ufaka igoli elilodwa.

lessons.title: Imikhumbi yaseThekwini
lessons.summary: Little Melokuhle and her father Jabu visit the sea in Durban to watch the ships; she points at a huge ship coming in, learns it will leave tomorrow, and they hurry back the next morning to see it go.
lessons.text:
UMelokuhle uyintombazane encane. Uhlala eThekwini noyise, uJabu. Ngomgqibelo uJabu uthi: "Namuhla sizohambela ulwandle. Sizobona imikhumbi."

Bafika olwandle ekuseni. Bahlala eduze nolwandle. Lapho kufika imikhumbi eminingi. Eminye mincane, eminye mikhulu kakhulu.

Bese umkhumbi omkhulu uqhamuka phakathi olwandle. UMelokuhle uyakhomba. Uthi: "Baba, bheka! Kukhona umkhumbi oqhamukayo!" UJabu ubheka lapho akhomba khona. Uthi: "Yebo, umkhumbi omkhulu uyeza."

Umkhumbi uyeza kancane. Manje ufika eduze nabo. UMelokuhle uyabuza: "Lo mkhumbi uqhamukaphi?" UJabu uthi: "Uqhamuka kwamanye amazwe. Uhamba olwandle lolo izinsuku eziningi."

UMelokuhle uyakhomba futhi. Uthi: "Abantu bomkhumbi bazohamba nini?" UJabu uyabuza indoda esebenza lapho. Indoda ithi: "Umkhumbi uzohamba kusasa ekuseni, ngehora 7."

UMelokuhle uthi: "Baba, asibuye kusasa! Ngifuna ukubona umkhumbi uhamba." UJabu uthi: "Kulungile. Kodwa kumele siphuthume kusasa ekuseni."

Ngosuku olulandelayo uJabu uvusa uMelokuhle ekuseni kakhulu. Uthi: "Phuthuma! Umkhumbi uzohamba ngehora 7!" Bayaphuthuma, baye olwandle. Bafika ngehora 6. Bahlala lapho, eduze nolwandle lolo.

Ngehora 7 umkhumbi omkhulu uyemuka. UMelokuhle uyawubheka uze ube mncane kakhulu. Uthi: "Baba, ngolunye usuku nami ngizohamba ngomkhumbi."

Imibuzo:
UMelokuhle noyise bahambela ulwandle na?
Kunjalo, bahambela ulwandle ukuze babone imikhumbi.
Umkhumbi omkhulu uqhamuka phakathi olwandle na?
Kunjalo, uqhamuka kwamanye amazwe.
UMelokuhle uyakhomba umkhumbi na?
Kunjalo, uyakhomba umkhumbi oqhamukayo.
Umkhumbi uzohamba nini?
Uzohamba kusasa ekuseni, ngehora 7.
Bayaphuthuma ngosuku olulandelayo na?
Kunjalo, bayaphuthuma, baye olwandle.

lessons.title: Ipulazi likaMpumelelo
lessons.summary: Tired of noisy Johannesburg, Mpumelelo moved to a small farm near Ladysmith; fuel is dear, so he cuts his trips to town, his money is enough for the tax, and when the water pump stops he finds it needs oil and fixes it himself.
lessons.text:
UMpumelelo wahlala eGoli iminyaka eminingi. Wasebenza ehhovisi elikhulu. EGoli wahlupheka kakhulu ngenxa yomsindo nomsebenzi omningi.

Ngonyaka odlule uMpumelelo wathutha. Wathenga ipulazi elincane eduze naseMnambithi. Manje uhlala epulazini lakhe. Lapha uyakhululeka. Akahlupheki futhi.

Ekuseni uMpumelelo uqoqa izithelo ensimini yakhe. Uziqoqa, azibeke esikhwameni. Ngemuva kwalokho uhlala ngaphandle, akhululeke elangeni.

Kodwa manje amafutha emoto abiza kakhulu. Intengo yamafutha ikhuphukile. Ngakho uMpumelelo unciphisa ukuhamba kwakhe ngemoto. Uya edolobheni kanye ngesonto kuphela. Ukunciphisa ukuhamba kwakhe kumsiza.

Imali yakhe incane kunaseGoli, kodwa iyanela. Njalo ngonyaka ukhokha intela yepulazi. Intela incane. Imali yakhe yanele intela nokudla.

Ngolunye usuku kunenkinga epulazini. Insimu ayinawo amanzi. Umshini wamanzi awusebenzi. UMpumelelo uyawubheka umshini. Ufuna ukuxazulula le nkinga yena uqobo. Ekugcineni uthola ukuthi umshini udinga amafutha. Ufaka amafutha emshinini, futhi umshini uyasebenza futhi. Uyixazulule inkinga.

Umngane wakhe waseGoli uyamshayela ucingo. Uyabuza: "Awufuni ukubuyela eGoli?" UMpumelelo uthi: "Cha. Lapha epulazini ngiyakhululeka. Angihlupheki futhi."

Imibuzo:
UMpumelelo wahlupheka eGoli na?
Kunjalo, wahlupheka ngenxa yomsindo nomsebenzi omningi.
UMpumelelo wathuthela epulazini na?
Kunjalo, wathenga ipulazi elincane eduze naseMnambithi.
Amafutha emoto abiza kancane na?
Cha, abiza kakhulu manje.
Imali yakhe iyanela na?
Kunjalo, incane kunaseGoli, kodwa iyanela.
UMpumelelo uyixazulula inkinga yomshini na?
Kunjalo, ufaka amafutha emshinini.

lessons.title: Usuku lwenkululeko
lessons.summary: On Freedom Day the headman Nqobizitha gathers thousands of people near Mtubatuba; old Sizakele reads from the Bible and tells how the police once arrested her, and everyone eats together and promises to meet again.
lessons.text:
Namhlanje lusuku lwenkululeko. Endaweni encane eduze naseMtubatuba, induna uNqobizitha ibiza abantu bendawo. Ifuna ukuthi bonke abantu bakhumbule inkululeko yabo ndawonye.

Abantu abaningi bayeza. Kukhona izinkulungwane zabantu: abantu abadala, abasha nezingane. Bonke bayathokoza.

Induna ithi: "Namhlanje sizokhumbula inkululeko yethu ndawonye. Kuqala uSizakele uzofunda ibhayibheli."

USizakele ungowesifazane omdala kakhulu. Uyaphenduka, abheke abantu. Uvula ibhayibheli, alifunde ngezwi elikhulu.

Bese uthi: "Kudala amaphoyisa angibopha. Ngahlala ejele unyaka owodwa, ngoba ngafuna inkululeko. Ngaleso sikhathi amaphoyisa abopha abantu abaningi."

Abantu bayalalela. Ingane encane iyaphenduka, ibheke unina. Iyabuza: "Mama, kungani amaphoyisa ambopha?" Unina uthi: "Ngoba wafuna inkululeko. Namhlanje sinayo."

Bese induna iphinde ikhulume. Ithi: "Sithokoza ngenkululeko yethu. Asisebenze ndawonye, sakhe indawo yethu." Abantu bayavuma. Bayathokoza.

Ngemuva kwalokho abantu badla ndawonye. Kukhona inyama nokudla okuningi okumnandi. Izinkulungwane zabantu ziyadla, ziyaphuza, futhi ziyaxoxa.

Ekugcineni induna iphinde ikhulume. Ithi: "Ngiyajabula ngokuza kwenu. Ngonyaka ozayo asiphinde sihlangane lapha, ndawonye." USizakele uthi: "Nami ngizophinde ngifunde ibhayibheli."

Imibuzo:
Namhlanje lusuku lwenkululeko na?
Kunjalo, namhlanje lusuku lwenkululeko.
Induna ibiza abantu bendawo na?
Kunjalo, induna uNqobizitha ibiza abantu bendawo.
Kufika abantu abambalwa kuphela na?
Cha, kukhona izinkulungwane zabantu.
USizakele uyaphenduka, abheke abantu na?
Kunjalo, uyaphenduka, abheke abantu, bese efunda ibhayibheli.
Amaphoyisa ambopha uSizakele kudala na?
Kunjalo, ambopha ngoba wafuna inkululeko.
